key_points_wrong: pre-task describes registering NEW server with LB before update, which is backwards -- you should deregister from LB before updating, then re-register after
post-task describes deregistering OLD server which is also backwards
brief_justification: Has the right components (serial, health checks, block/rescue) but the LB registration flow is inverted. The correct flow is: deregister from LB, deploy, health check, re-register to LB.
